Health made accessible with YAKAP and 1Life

Through the YAKAP Program, PhilHealth and 1Life bring you closer to quality healthcare with free doctor's consultations, essential laboratory tests, and access to medicines — all designed to keep you healthy and supported throughout the year.

What is YAKAP?

PhilHealth YAKAP is all about bringing healthcare closer to every Filipino in a simple and caring way. Through this program, members are connected to trusted YAKAP providers like 1Life, where they can enjoy free doctor's consultations, essential laboratory tests, and medicines. YAKAP focuses on early detection, disease prevention, and continuous care — making sure every member has a reliable partner in staying healthy all year round.

Be a YAKAP Member

What is 1Life?

1Life is a PhilHealth-accredited clinic dedicated to delivering proactive, patient-centered healthcare. Beyond consultations, 1Life provides continuous guidance and support throughout the year, ensuring that patients don't just get treated when sick but are cared for in maintaining long-term wellness. With a focus on prevention, accessibility, and compassion, 1Life partners with PhilHealth to make quality healthcare more affordable and within reach for every Filipino.

Learn more about 1LIFE

1Life Partners

Guided by the Universal Health Care (UHC) Act, PhilHealth is committed to ensuring that every Filipino has access to quality and affordable healthcare. By championing initiatives like YAKAP, PhilHealth strengthens its role in protecting, supporting, and caring for Filipinos' health, bringing the promise of universal healthcare closer to every community.

Learn More

Through the YAKAP Program, PhilHealth partners with 1Life to make this vision a reality—offering free doctor consultations, essential laboratory tests, and access to medicines for members across the country.

Learn More

1Life is a trusted YAKAP and G.A.M.O.T. Provider, improving access to quality healthcare and leveraging innovative technology to help prevent complications and simplify health processes for Filipinos. With a strong focus on disease prevention, we empower patients and communities through timely support, early intervention, and a more proactive approach to healthcare.

What is Hypercare?

Ipagpatuloy ang iyong pag-aalaga sa sarili sa pamamagitan ng LIBRENG Hypercare Services. Nais namin na ang bawat Pilipino ay manatiling malusog at malayo sa sakit sa tulong ng makabagong teknolohiya.

Naniniwala kami na ang pangangalaga sa kalusugan ay hindi dapat maging mahirap o magastos. Kaya pinadali namin ang paggamit sa pamamagitan ng Hypercare Services—isang integrated healthcare solution na nag-aalok ng kumpletong serbisyo mula sa konsultasyon at laboratory tests hanggang sa gamot. Lahat ito ay accessible at inaakma para sa pangangailangan ng bawat pasyente.
